title: Cadeler signs $282m loan facility for turbine installation vessel
summary: Cadeler has secured a €247 million ($282 million) senior secured "green" term loan facility to partially fund the construction of its new wind turbine installation vessel, Wind Apex. The vessel is expected to be delivered in the second quarter of 2027 and is being built by COSCO Shipping Qidong Offshore in China. title: Microsoft Entra ID authentication overhaul to start in September 2026
summary: Microsoft is set to implement a significant overhaul of its Entra ID authentication process, beginning September 1, 2026, by making passkeys the default authentication method. This change will require users currently relying on SMS or voice authentication for MFA to register a passkey, with automatic passkey registration prompts enforced for all users by February 1, 2027. Consequently, Microsoft will phase out its native SMS and voice authentication, instead providing options for organizations to utilize third-party telecom providers for these services.

title: EAN 2026: Sanofi’s Cenrifki post hoc data suggests lesions may not indicate failure
summary: Sanofi presented post hoc data at EAN 2026 for its drug Cenrifki (tolebrutinib) in multiple sclerosis, suggesting that local inflammatory lesions observed during treatment may not indicate treatment failure. The analysis of the HERCULES and GEMINI trials showed Cenrifki reduced confirmed disability accumulation regardless of new focal inflammatory lesions, challenging conventional clinical interpretations. summary: Sanofi is preparing to expand the use of its Pompe therapy, Nexviazyme, to include patients diagnosed in infancy, following positive results from the phase 3 Baby-COMET study.
